hypothesis: A true initiative opening drive should accept on the first completed five-minute bar and extend jointly in CL and MCL on the second; dominant-book effort on that second step is the primary categorical definition. Absorption and two-bar initiative failure retain their already-frozen clocks.

profiles_in_frozen_selection_order.law: first CL/MCL closes both accept beyond their opening-auction closes; second CL/MCL closes both extend farther in source direction; second CL volume is at least first CL volume and MCL volume is positive
same two-step joint price acceptance and extension without the second-step CL volume comparison
profiles_in_frozen_selection_order.role: count-eligibility fallback only if the effort primary is ineligible

unchanged_branches.initiative_failure: retain exact selected two-bar V37 event

selection_law: Select the first profile in frozen order passing all count gates in both periods. Only it may receive a costed lifecycle preregistration.
prohibitions: no volume multiplier or percentile sweep
no branch, anchor, side, direction, month, or regime deletion
